changes: Map ODM paths to vendor/odm as stored in this Recovery
Combine composer fixups so Python dict keys do not discard changes
Firmware included using standard extract-utils generation: Global scp only; all other stock firmware and stock AVB images excluded
Use original stock Widevine APEX SHA-1 1ab71fd60c1f96932979b1a9ae76786aa13e8642 instead of upstream foreign pin
Preserve authored IMS integration when cleaning generated vendor blobs
Add omitted stock mmagent/nvram AIDL services and tetheroffload init/VINTF registration; include missing nvram-V1-ndk direct dependency
Register EXTRACT_ONLY ODM SKU inputs using ODM_MANIFEST_SKUS and ODM_MANIFEST_<SKU>_FILES; platform android-info.mk generates and assembles the SKU modules without custom Soong rules
proprietary_binaries: Not redistributed by this repository; extracted from user-provided locked official archive

additional_changes.change: Extract 32-bit mapper and four matching graphics dependencies; apply the existing graphics common AIDL fixup to both architectures.
Expose peak refresh rate choices queried from supported display modes; no invented refresh rates.

Install the stock power profile under res/xml; all 38 named entries numerically match the locked Global stock overlay after correcting u.core_power.cluster1 to cpu.core_power.cluster1. This supplies battery usage estimates, not performance tuning.
Add the stock config_mainDisplayShape from DevicesAndroidOverlay; preserve existing cutout dimensions.

Use a device-specific AIDL Health wrapper with fixed mAh-to-uAh charge-counter conversion for the pinned Global 6.6.118 kernel, independently confirmed on the connected device. Do not import magnitude/SOC heuristics; current and full capacity already use micro-units. Keep the existing board charger startup order.
